book.name: Matiu
book.title: Matiu Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Matiu girumalena

content: Iesu apana kero kito wadawadalala inasade
Iesu wadiwae iene wiseno apana uaraia me warorosane do antoiena.
Ita sape apana kito wadawadalala Iesu mampe wisene me wawa bumpe imimpa emmisilene diene wanase, “Tatamba, naita e meneempa e rua os ne inanea!”
Me epe iririsano Iesu me ibuwa wadene diene wanase, “Ne sauepaa menanede, inaitaa!” Me epe wano tauwadea kito etepa uduudu osowelena diantono inalen.

Ita Iesu me diene wanase, “E inaitena umanawa mai apana da diamoa, dia, tane dodomana aite pirisi mampe etea euwasawo ewepi. Muriwa Moses anaanawa wana rua e inaitena pulowa ituno apana ewapue atentopu e inaitene euiten, God duwe aitaa rua.”
Iesu Rom sorodiawa debama nolawa dewalala inasade
Iesu Kapeanaum bedewe odedio Rom sorodiawa debama me mampe wisene sau baiwa iririsane wane wanase,
“Sona, ne nolana dewalala kero wadeno dunawo ituleide. Me etepa mai tepala, dainawa di winede ita do pokaida etede.”
Ita Iesu me diene wanase, “Ne anteape me inasapa.”
Tane Rom sorodiawa debama leusane wanase, “Debamana, ne mai apana euda wainipona ita e wine dunawo odaa, dia. E nambe enee aia os wawo ne nolana dewalala inalepi.

Ne apana nola baiwa empuitue diapuo dewasapia ateina wainedina. Ne sorodia debamau onanawoa dianeio ruauntedine nolantedina. Ita ne sorodiana atonawo waimoia dima diamodina ruawantoie nolantoi, mai eipona, dia. Ne sorodiana dea diape wapaase, ‘E aitaa!’ me aiana ruawalepie alepi, mai eipona, dia. Ita sorodiana da diape wapaase, ‘Ne mainawo wina!’ me wimpi. Tane nolana dewalala da diape wapaase, ‘Nola ema dewasaa!’ me ruawalepie dewasapi.”
Iesu aia ema etene memesalene apana wawe ieia diamone wanase, “Ne dialedina, Israel apanawa bedeuwo mai apana da sumanaiwa debamaia Rom sorodiawa ema sumanailena rua donsapona, dia.
Ne ulaipa dialedina, apana uaraia tawo moawa uduudu bedeuwoe wimopue God gonaawa bedewe Abraam, Aisak ita Iakob do bolau imaala wineiawo wampue odantompe nuaeuntompe os waimompa.
Tane apana mida bautaido God gonaawa baiwa sonabamona mo aubamopi bola kadiwaida iwinidaleidia bedewe. Sape mo ke wampe poka etaidasampe asipu adompa.”

Iesu mo epe diamone aupe Rom sorodiawa debama diene wanase, “Leuite aitaa bolaawo, dima sumanaiwaitena rua segalepi.” Iesu aia ema wadio omo sa deawaa bedewe Rom sorodiawa debama me nolawa dewalala inalen.
Iesu kerolala uara inamode
Ema aupe Iesu alene Pita duwa bedewe oden. Sape me Pita nemonapa kero wadeno etepa polaida wano ituwa bolawe ituleidio ewen.
Ita Iesu me mampelene witapa wadeno polapola eno inalene enene me baiwa simbialen.
Rawi sawo apana sosou uara aleu kadiwa bedeuwo wanwanlala banlamone Iesu mampe wimon. Tane Iesu aiawa os mampe aleu kadiwa tanamono nomon ita me kerolala uduudu inamon.
Me ema epe dewasana dima peroweta Aisaia wana ulaipalepia baiwa. Aisaia bukawa bedewe ema epe wadi wadiase,

content.text: “Me no keromba ita pokamba daitada awanenaubene eunen.”

content: Mida Iesu wawe alepia rua?
Tane apana uaraia Iesu enane paneieno me ewamone baiwa wawe alala diamone wanase, “Sosona, nawate doa waiwa dawo antata.” Iesu mo epe diamona rua waa bedewe odane nawane anton.
Tane mo doa waiwa dawo wimoieno anaana waeuwalala apanawa dea Iesu mampe wisene diene wanase, “Debamana, e na aitona ne waroroa wananteape do lakasantata, mai eepa, dia!”
Iesu me sipoasane wanase, “Ibou waimompadewantompaa nagau winede, ita do nene itudewantompaa dubu wineio waimoi, tane Apana Otopa mai bolawa da wineipona ita uwawa itupidewae bubualepi, dia.”
Iesu warorosaia apanawa da wisene me diene wanase, “Tatamba, ne mamana bolena baiwa bauta eneawo anteape me dobonteape muriwa leunteape wineape waroroepa.”
Tane Iesu leusane diene wanase, “Sa dia, e ne waroronea! Apana bolala waimoia muba sou bolena dobontopu.”
Iesu wadio lawara debama dialeide
Iesu aia ema wano dialeno aupe me waa bedewe odeno ita wawe alala warorosane do anton.
Madiaida bedewe mo mai moina da eteipono lawara debamaia esa osowe tauwadea os wisene epeno waa kadiwa osowe odene monulepona baiwaleidie. Tane Iesu ituleidie.
Ita wawe alala saidantone Iesu mampe antone wadanamesane waienase, “Tatamba, no saunee inanea, no kerauda os bontataa baiwantitana!”

Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Dima baiwa saidaitilana? E sumanaila keraulena baiwa epe dewaitilana!” Iesu mo epe diamone aupe enene lawara ita rauwanaga mampo badowa wana dainantopu, ita lawara dialeno sala uduudu dainalen.
Tane wawe alala ginasa ema ewane memesaidantone waienase, “Me apana dainea? Me wadio lawara ita rauwanaga ruawantoie dainantoi!”
Iesu apana nata bedeuwo aleu kadiwa tanamode

Iesu lawara ita rauwanaga dieno aisidene dialeno aupe mo au antoiawo antone doa Galili waiwa dawo bola ebowa Gadara bedewe wimoiena. Sape apana nata bedeuwo aleu kadiwa wanwanlala bo gubauwo waimoia nomone Iesu donsaiena. Mo nata pokawaauida onawaau, sa baiwa mai mida mo mampointa antopua rua, inta sa nuasasanaidalen.
Mo Iesu ewane siribabantone waienase, “God Otopa, e mai nolaa da no mainimbo wineipona, dia! Kotu walamawa ando wisepi, tane e meneedia no tauma matangelanea baiwa wien, ba?”
Tane maidana bono uara labantoie leie,
sa baiwa aleu kadiwa Iesu iririsane waienase, “No atenten e tananea, sa baiwa no menanedia e waaubanewo nonete ane bono sa bedeuwo odate wanta.”
Ita Iesu mo diamone wanase, “Nolene aitana!” Aleu kadiwa Iesu aiawa ruawantone apana nata emone nomone antoiena bono bedeuwo. Ita bono uara sa daiwa antono doa numamon.
Bono oniamoia apanawa epe ewane ene weuwane antone bola debama bedewe dima sape segalena ita do apana bedeuwo aleu kadiwa wanwanlala inantona umanawa benemantoie antoie.
Ita bola debamauwo wanwanlala uduudu mo benemau etane bolau ene Iesu donsapua baiwa antoiena. Ita mo Iesu ewane badowa iririsaiena mo bolau epie alepi.
